1.title: Supplication Before Sleeping 1
1.meaning: In Your name my Lord, I lie on my side and in Your name I rise. If You should take my soul then have mercy on it, and if You should return it then protect it as You protect Your righteous slaves.
1.description: Al-Bukhari 11/126, Muslim 4/2084. When one of you rises from his bed and then returns to it, he should dust it off with the edge of his lower garment three times. When he lies down he should say: (the above dua).

2.title: Supplication Before Sleeping 2
2.meaning: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
2.description: Al-Bukhari 6324. The Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) used to say this when going to bed.

3.title: Supplication for Fear and Loneliness During Sleep
3.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His slaves, and from the incitements of devils and from their presence.

4.title: Supplication for Turning Over During the Night
4.meaning: There is no god but Allah, the One, the Victorious, Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty, the All-Forgiving.
4.description: Al-Hakim, Adz-Dzahabi 1/540, An-Nasa'i, Ibnus Sunni. The Prophet (PBUH) used to say this when turning from one side to another during the night.

5.title: Supplication if Awakened During the Night
5.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. Praise is to Allah, Glory is to Allah, None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Allah is the Most Great, and there is no power and no might except by Allah.
5.description: Al-Bukhari 1103, Abu Dawud 5060. Whoever says this when he wakes up at night and then asks for forgiveness, his prayer will be answered.

6.title: Supplication Upon Waking Up 1
6.meaning: Praise is to Allah Who gives us life after He has caused us to die and to Him is the return.

7.title: Supplication Upon Waking Up 2
7.meaning: Praise is to Allah Who has provided me with well-being in my body, has returned my soul to me and has permitted me to remember Him.

8.title: Supplication Before Entering the Toilet
8.meaning: (In the name of Allah). O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils.

9.title: Supplication After Leaving the Toilet
9.description: Recorded by all the authors of the Sunan except An-Nasa'i. See Takhrij Zaadul Ma'aad 2/387.

10.title: Supplication Before Ablution
10.description: Abu Dawud, Ibnu Majah, Ahmad. See Irwa'ul Ghalil 1/122.

11.title: Supplication After Completing Ablution
11.meaning: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner; and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger.

12.title: Supplication for Wearing Clothes
12.meaning: Praise is to Allah Who has clothed me with this (garment) and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.
12.description: Recorded by the authors of the Sunan except An-Nasa'i. See Irwa'ul Ghalil 7/47.

13.title: Supplication for Wearing New Clothes
13.meaning: O Allah, praise is to You. You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness of what it was made for, and I seek Your protection from its evil and the evil of what it was made for.
13.description: Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidzi. See Al-Albani, Mukhtasar Shamailit-Tirmidhi, p. 47.

14.title: Supplication Before Undressing
14.description: Ibnu Majah 2/1178. See Sahih Ibnu Majah 2/275.

15.title: Seeking Refuge from Evil
15.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the withdrawal of Your blessing, and the change of Your protection (from good to bad), and from Your sudden wrath, and from every expression of Your displeasure.

16.title: Supplication Against Laziness, Weakness, Senility, and Miserliness
16.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from laziness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice, and I seek refuge in You from senility, and I seek refuge in You from miserliness.

17.title: Supplication Against Shirk
17.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should associate anything with You while I know it, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.
17.description: Ahmad 4/403. See Sahihul Jami' 3/233 and Sahihut Targhrib wat Tarhib 1/19.

18.title: Supplication for Wind, Thunder, and Rain
18.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness and I seek refuge in You from its evil.
18.description: Abu Dawud 4/326, Ibnu Majah 2/1228. See Sahih Ibnu Majah 2/305.

19.title: Supplication for Rain
19.meaning: O Allah, shower upon us a helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial and not harmful, immediately and not delayed.
19.description: Abu Dawud 1/303, Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1/216.

20.title: Supplication When it Rains
20.meaning: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rainstorm.
20.description: Al-Bukhari no. 985. The Prophet (PBUH) used to say this when it rained.

21.title: Supplication for Heavy Rain or to Stop Rain
21.meaning: O Allah, let it rain around us and not upon us.

22.title: Dua for the Newlyweds
22.meaning: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.

23.title: Dua of Groom for His Bride
23.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for her goodness and the goodness of what You have made her nature, and I seek Your protection from her evil and the evil of what You have made her nature.
23.description: Abu Dawud 2/248, Ibnu Majah 1/617. See Sahih Ibnu Majah 1/324.

24.title: Supplication Before Intercourse
24.meaning: In the Name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from that which You provide for us.

25.title: Supplication When Feeling Pain
25.meaning: In the Name of Allah (3x). I seek refuge in Allah and His Power from the evil of what I find and of what I fear (7x).
25.description: Muslim 4/1728. Place your hand on the part of the body where you feel pain and say the above.

26.title: Dua of Prophet Ayyub in Sickness
26.meaning: My Lord, indeed adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.
26.description: Quran 21:83. The dua of Prophet Ayyub during his trial.

27.title: Supplication for a Sick Person
27.meaning: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the hardship, heal (him/her), You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing which leaves no illness behind.

28.title: Supplication for One Whose Life is Near its End
28.meaning: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me and join me with the Highest Companion (the angels).
28.description: Al-Bukhari 7/10, Muslim 4/1893. These were the last words of the Prophet (PBUH).

29.title: Instructing (Talqin) the Dying
29.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah.
29.description: Abu Dawud 3/190. See Sahihul Jami' 5/432. Whoever's last words are 'La ilaha illallah' will enter Paradise.

30.title: Supplication When Closing the Eyes of the Deceased
30.meaning: O Allah, forgive [name of the person] and elevate his station among those who are guided. Send him along the path of those who came before, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Enlarge for him his grave and shed light upon him in it.
30.description: Muslim 2/634. Replace the word [name] with the name of the deceased.

31.title: Supplication for Condolence (Ta'ziyah)
31.meaning: Surely, to Allah belongs what He has taken, and to Him belongs what He has given, and everything has with Him an appointed time; so have patience and seek reward from Him.

32.title: Dua for Placing the Deceased in the Grave
32.meaning: In the Name of Allah and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
32.description: Abu Dawud 3/314 with a Sahih chain of narration.

33.title: Supplication After Burying the Deceased
33.meaning: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, make him firm.
33.description: Abu Dawud 3/315, Al-Hakim. The Prophet (PBUH) used to stand over the grave after burial and say: Ask for forgiveness for your brother and ask for him to be made firm, for he is being questioned now.

34.title: Supplication for Visiting Graves
34.meaning: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of the dwellings, among the believers and the Muslims. Indeed we shall, Allah willing, be united with you. (May Allah have mercy on those of us who have gone before and those who are to follow). We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.

35.title: Supplication for Grief and Anxiety
35.meaning: O Allah, I am Your slave and the son of Your male slave and the son of Your female slave. My forehead is in Your hand. Your judgment upon me is assured and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every Name that You have named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or taught any one of Your creation, or kept unto Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen that is with You, to make the Quran the spring of my heart, and the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness and the reliever of my distress.
35.description: Ahmad 1/391. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

36.title: Supplication for Times of Difficulty
36.meaning: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty easy, if You wish.
36.description: Ibnu Hibban no. 2427, Ibnus Sunni no. 351.

37.title: Dua of Prophet Yunus in Difficulty
37.meaning: There is no god but You, Glory be to You, surely I have been among the wrongdoers.

38.title: Supplication if Stricken by a Calamity
38.meaning: Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it with something better.

39.title: Supplication Upon Seeing Someone in Affliction
39.meaning: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me from what He has afflicted you with, and for favoring me over many of His creation.

40.title: Supplication if Something Distressful Occurs
40.meaning: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.

41.title: Supplication if Something Pleasing Occurs
41.meaning: Praise is to Allah Who by His blessing all good things are perfected.

42.title: When Something Joyful Happens
42.meaning: Whenever something joyful happened to Prophet Muhammad SAW or he received good news, he would prostrate in gratitude to Allah.
42.description: Narrated by Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi, and Ibnu Majah. See Sahih Ibnu Majah 1/233.

43.title: Supplication for Settlement of Debt
43.meaning: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful to keep me away from what is prohibited, and make me independent of all others besides You.

44.title: Dua for Someone Who Offers You Their Wealth
44.meaning: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth.

45.title: Dua for the Lender When Settling a Debt
45.meaning: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth. Surely, the reward for a loan is praise and repayment.

46.title: Supplication in Times of Restricted Provision
46.meaning: O Allah, I ask You of Your grace and Your mercy, for indeed, none possesses them but You.
46.description: At-Thabrani, Al-Albani in Silsilah Sahihah no 1543.

47.title: Supplication When People are Occupied with Wealth
47.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for steadfastness in the matter and resolve upon guidance. I ask You for the means of Your mercy and the resolve of Your forgiveness. I ask You for gratitude for Your blessing and excellence in Your worship. I ask You for a sound heart and a truthful tongue. I ask You for the good of what You know, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You know, and I ask Your forgiveness for what You know. Indeed, You are the Knower of the Unseen.

48.title: Supplication for Riding a Vehicle
48.meaning: In the Name of Allah. Praise is to Allah. (Glory is to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we were not able to do it ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we are returning). Praise is to Allah (thrice). Allah is the Most Great (thrice). Glory is to You, O Allah, I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for indeed none forgives sins but You.

49.title: The Traveler's Dua for Those Staying Behind
49.meaning: I entrust you to Allah, to Whom nothing entrusted is ever lost.

50.title: The Staying Person's Dua for the Traveler
50.meaning: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and your final deeds.

51.title: Supplication for Starting a Journey
51.meaning: Allah is the Most Great (thrice). (Glory is to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we were not able to do it ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we are returning). O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey of ours easy for us and make its distance short for us. O Allah, You are our Companion on the journey and the Caretaker of our family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a dismal sight and from a bad return in wealth and family.

52.title: The Traveler's Dua Before Dawn
52.meaning: He who listens has heard our praise of Allah for His testing of us that was good. Our Lord, be our Companion and bestow Your favor upon us, as we seek refuge in Allah from the Fire.

53.title: Supplication for Stopping at a Place
53.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

54.title: Supplication Before Entering a Town or City
54.meaning: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and what they overshadow, Lord of the seven earths and what they contain, Lord of the devils and what they mislead, Lord of the winds and what they blow. I ask You for the good of this town, the good of its people, and the good of what is in it. I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people, and the evil of what is in it.

55.title: Supplication for Entering the Marketplace
55.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He brings life and He causes death, and He is Living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He is Able to do all things.
55.description: At-Tirmidzi 5/291, Al-Hakim 1/538. Classed as Hasan by Al-Albani.

56.title: Supplication if an Animal or Vehicle Stumbles
56.description: Abu Dawud 4/296. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

57.title: Supplication Upon Returning from Travel
57.meaning: Allah is the Most Great (thrice). None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. We return, repentant, worshipping, and praising our Lord. Allah has fulfilled His promise, helped His slave, and alone He defeated the confederates.

58.title: Supplication for Protection from Satan
58.meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

59.title: Supplication Against the Distraction of Satan During Prayer
59.meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast. (Then spit [dryly] to your left three times).

60.group: Supplications for Paradise and Protection from Hell
60.title: Supplication for Paradise and Protection from Hellfire
60.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek Your protection from the Fire.
60.description: Abu Dawud no. 792, Ibnu Majah no. 910. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

61.group: Supplications for Paradise and Protection from Hell
61.title: Supplication for Paradise, Protection from Hell and Good Decree
61.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever speech or deed brings one near to it, and I seek Your protection from Hell and whatever speech or deed brings one near to it, and I ask You to make every decree You have ordained for me good.
61.description: Ibnu Majah no. 3846, Ahmad 1/172. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

62.group: Supplications for Paradise and Protection from Hell
62.title: Supplication for Protection from Hell
62.meaning: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering; Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.

63.title: Supplication for Good Character
63.meaning: O Allah, You have made my physical creation beautiful, so make my character beautiful.
63.description: Ahmad, classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

64.title: Supplication for Good Character and Deeds
64.meaning: O Allah, guide me to the best of deeds and the best of character, none guides to the best of them but You. And protect me from evil deeds and evil character, none protects from the evil of them but You.

65.title: Supplication Against Bad Character
65.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil character, evil deeds, and evil desires.

66.title: Dua for Forgiveness for Oneself and Parents
66.meaning: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

67.title: Prophet Nuh's Dua for Forgiveness
67.meaning: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.

68.title: Supplication for Mercy for Parents
68.meaning: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.

69.title: Supplication for a Comforting Family
69.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

70.title: Supplication for Wealth, Children, Long Life, Good Deeds and Forgiveness
70.meaning: O Allah, increase my wealth and children, and bless me in what You have given me. Lengthen my life in obedience to You, and make my deeds good and forgive me.

71.title: Supplication for Righteous Children
71.meaning: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.

72.title: Supplication for Offspring
72.meaning: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors.

73.title: Supplication for Gratitude, Good Deeds and Righteous Children
73.meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have turned to You in repentance, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

74.title: Congratulating Parents on the Birth of a Child
74.meaning: May Allah bless you with His gift to you, and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness.

75.title: Supplication for Children's Chastity
75.meaning: O Allah, forgive his/her sin, purify his/her heart, and guard his/her chastity.
75.description: Recorded by Ahmad, At-Thabrani, Al-Baihaqi. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

76.title: Supplication for Protecting a Newborn Child
76.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You for him/her and his/her offspring from Satan, the outcast.

77.title: The Prophet's (PBUH) Dua for Protecting Children
77.meaning: I seek refuge for you in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature and from every evil eye.

78.title: Supplication for Steadfastness of Heart
78.meaning: O Turner of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
78.description: At-Tirmidzi no. 3522. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

79.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
79.title: Supplication for Forgiveness and Mercy
79.meaning: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.

80.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
80.title: Prophet Adam's Dua for Forgiveness
80.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

81.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
81.title: Prophet Musa's Dua for Forgiveness
81.meaning: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me.

82.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
82.title: Supplication for Forgiveness, Mercy, Guidance, Well-being and Provision
82.meaning: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.

83.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
83.title: Comprehensive Dua for Forgiveness and Well-being
83.meaning: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.

84.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
84.title: Supplication for Forgiveness, Firmness and Victory
84.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

85.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
85.title: Supplication for All-Encompassing Forgiveness
85.meaning: O Allah, forgive me my sin, my ignorance, my exceeding the bounds in my affairs, and what You know better than I. O Allah, forgive me my seriousness, my playfulness, my mistakes and my deliberate acts, and all of that is within me. O Allah, forgive me for what I have done in the past and what I will do in the future, what I have concealed and what I have declared, and what You know better than I. You are the Advancer and You are the Delayer, and You have power over all things.

86.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
86.title: Supplication for Forgiveness and Protection from Hell
86.meaning: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

87.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
87.title: Supplication for Forgiveness and Honor on the Day of Resurrection
87.meaning: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.

88.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
88.title: Supplication for Forgiveness and Cleanliness of the Heart
88.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

89.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
89.title: Supplication for Forgiveness on the Day of Judgment
89.meaning: My Lord, forgive me my mistake on the Day of Judgment.

90.group: Supplications for Forgiveness, Mercy and Goodness
90.title: Prophet Musa's Dua for Mercy and Goodness
90.meaning: You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers. And ordain for us in this world [that which is] good and [also] in the Hereafter; indeed, we have turned back to You.

91.title: Supplication Against Shirk (Polytheism)
91.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should associate anything with You while I know it, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.

92.title: Supplication Seeking Refuge from Four Things
92.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge which does not benefit, from a heart which does not feel humble, from a soul which is never satisfied and from a supplication which is not answered.

93.group: Supplications Against Fatal Accidents and Horrible Death
93.title: Supplication Against Disasters and Terrible Endings
93.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from falling from a high place, from being crushed by a falling wall, from drowning, and from being burned. I seek refuge in You from being led astray by Satan at the time of death, from dying while fleeing from the battlefield for Your sake, and from dying from a poisonous sting.

94.group: Supplications Against Fatal Accidents and Horrible Death
94.title: Supplication Against Satan's Misguidance at Death
94.meaning: I seek refuge in You from being misled by Satan at the time of death.

95.title: Supplication for Knowledge 1
95.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

96.title: Supplication for Knowledge 2
96.meaning: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, and teach me that which will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

97.title: Supplication for Beneficial Knowledge
97.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge and I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit.

98.title: Supplication for Understanding the Religion
98.meaning: O Allah, grant me understanding of the religion.

99.title: Dua for Steadfastness in Prayer
99.meaning: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my offspring. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

100.title: Supplication for Gratitude and Good Deeds
100.meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.

101.title: Supplication for Guidance, Piety, Chastity and Contentment
101.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency.

102.title: Supplication for Piety and Purity of Soul
102.meaning: O Allah, grant my soul its piety and purify it, for You are the Best to purify it. You are its Guardian and its Protector.

103.title: Supplication for Ease and Clarity
103.meaning: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

104.title: Supplication for the Rectification of One's Affairs
104.meaning: O Allah, set right my religion which is the protection of my affairs, and set right my worldly life in which is my livelihood, and set right my hereafter which is my place of return. Make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a relief for me from every evil.

105.title: Supplication for Sighting the New Moon
105.meaning: Allah is the Most Great. O Allah, bring this moon over us with security and faith, safety and Islam, and with success for that which You love and are pleased with. Our Lord and your Lord (O moon) is Allah.
105.description: Ad-Darimi, At-Thabrani. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

106.title: Supplication Upon Seeing the First Fruit of the Season
106.meaning: O Allah, bless us in our fruit, bless us in our city, bless us in our Sa' and bless us in our Mudd.

107.title: Supplication for an Easy Reckoning
107.meaning: O Allah, grant me an easy reckoning.
107.description: Ahmad 6/48. Classed as Sahih by Shu'ayb Al-Arna'ut.

108.title: Supplication for Truthful Speech in Anger and Pleasure
108.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the word of truth in times of anger and pleasure.

109.title: Supplication for the Pleasure of Beholding Allah's Face
109.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for the pleasure of looking at Your Face and a longing to meet You, without any harmful hardship or misleading trial.
109.description: An-Nasa'i 1305. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

110.title: Supplication for Allah's Love
110.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Your love, and the love of those who love You, and the love of deeds that bring me closer to Your love.
110.description: At-Tirmidzi no. 3235. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

111.title: Supplication for Abundant Goodness
111.meaning: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the Unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive as long as You know that living is good for me, and take my life if You know that death is good for me. O Allah, I ask You for fear of You in secret and in public. I ask You for the word of truth in pleasure and in anger. I ask You for moderation in poverty and in wealth. I ask You for never-ending bliss. I ask You for a comfort of the eye that does not cease. I ask You for contentment after Your decree. I ask You for the coolness of life after death. I ask You for the delight of looking at Your Face and the longing to meet You, without any harmful hardship or misleading trial. O Allah, adorn us with the beauty of faith and make us guides who are rightly guided.
111.description: An-Nasa'i no. 1305. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

112.title: Supplication for Acceptance of Deeds and Repentance
112.meaning: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing. And accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

113.title: Supplication to be Among the Righteous
113.meaning: My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous. And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations. And make me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

114.title: Supplication for Reliance Upon Allah
114.meaning: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

115.title: Supplication for the Perfection of Light and Forgiveness
115.meaning: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

116.title: Supplication for Mercy and Right Guidance
116.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

117.title: Supplication to Die as a Muslim
117.meaning: You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

118.title: Supplication for Guidance and Correctness
118.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for guidance and correctness.

119.title: Supplication for Patience and Death in Faith
119.meaning: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].

120.title: Supplication for Life or Death According to What is Best
120.meaning: O Allah, keep me alive so long as life is good for me, and take my life if death is better for me.

121.title: Supplication for Firmness and Being a Guide
121.meaning: O Allah, make me firm and make me a guide who is rightly guided.

122.title: Supplication for Faith, Certainty, and Understanding
122.meaning: O Allah, increase us in faith, certainty, and understanding.
122.description: Recorded by Abdullah bin Ahmad, Sahih chain.

123.title: Supplication for Steadfastness in Islam
123.meaning: O Protector of Islam and its people, keep me firm on Islam until I meet You with it.

124.title: Supplication for Faith, Bliss and Companionship of the Prophet
124.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for faith that does not disappear, bliss that does not end, and the companionship of Muhammad (PBUH) in the highest level of the eternal Paradise.

125.title: Supplication for Contentment
125.meaning: O Allah, make me content with what You have provided me, bless me in it, and replace for me everything I have lost with something better.

126.title: Supplication for Guidance to the Right Way
126.meaning: Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way.

127.title: Supplication for Urgent Needs
127.meaning: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

128.group: Supplications for Entering and Leaving the Home
128.title: Supplication Before Leaving the House
128.meaning: In the Name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah, there is no power or might except by Allah.
128.description: Abu Dawud 5095, At-Tirmidzi 3426. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

129.group: Supplications for Entering and Leaving the Home
129.title: Supplication for Entering the House 1

130.group: Supplications for Entering and Leaving the Home
130.title: Supplication for Entering the House 2 (Greeting)

131.group: Supplications for Entering and Leaving the Home
131.title: Greeting Upon Entering an Empty House
131.meaning: Peace be upon us and upon the righteous slaves of Allah.

132.title: Words After the Adhan 1 - Version 1
132.meaning: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner, and that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger. I am content with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as my Messenger and with Islam as my religion.

133.title: Words After the Adhan 1 - Version 2
133.meaning: And I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner, and that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger. I am content with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as my Messenger and with Islam as my religion.

134.title: Supplication After the Adhan (Asking for Wasilah)
134.meaning: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer. Grant Muhammad the Wasilah and superiority, and raise him up to a praised platform which You have promised him.

136.title: If One Forgets to Say Bismillah Before Eating
136.meaning: In the Name of Allah at the beginning and at the end.

137.title: Supplication When Provided with Food
137.meaning: O Allah, bless us in it and feed us with something better than it.

138.title: Supplication for Drinking Milk
138.meaning: O Allah, bless us in it and give us more of it.

139.title: Supplication After Eating
139.meaning: Praise is to Allah Who has fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.

140.title: Supplication for the Person Who Fed You
140.meaning: O Allah, feed him who has fed me, and give drink to him who has given me drink.

141.title: Supplication for Breaking the Fast 1
141.meaning: The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
141.description: Abu Dawud no. 2357. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

142.title: Dua for Breaking the Fast in Someone Else's Home
142.meaning: May those who are fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angels send prayers upon you.
142.description: Abu Dawud no. 3854. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

143.title: Intention for Fasting in Ramadan
143.meaning: I intend to fast tomorrow to fulfill the obligation of the month of Ramadan this year for the sake of Allah the Almighty.
143.description: The intention is made in the heart during the night before dawn.

144.title: Eid Greeting
144.meaning: May Allah accept [good deeds] from us and from you.
144.description: Said when meeting fellow Muslims on Eid al-Fitr or Eid al-Adha.

145.title: Supplication for Slaughtering Sacrificial Animals
145.meaning: In the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great. O Allah, this is from You and for You. O Allah, accept it from me.

146.title: The Eid Takbir
146.meaning: Allah is the Most Great, Allah is the Most Great, Allah is the Most Great. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah. Allah is the Most Great, Allah is the Most Great, and to Him belongs all praise.
146.description: Recited from the night of Eid until the Imam comes out for the prayer.

147.title: Supplication for Protection from the Fitnah of Dajjal
147.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the fitnah (trial) of the Dajjal.
147.description: Recited during the final Tashahhud before the Salaam.

148.title: Supplication for Protection from the Punishment of Grave and Hell
148.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and from the punishment of Hell.

149.title: Supplication Against Dangerous Diseases
149.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from vitiligo, madness, leprosy, and from all evil diseases.
149.description: Abu Dawud no. 1554. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

150.title: Supplication Against the Evil of Self and Satan
150.meaning: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of Satan.

151.title: Supplication for Protection from Life's Hardships
151.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the severe burden of trials, being overtaken by misery, evil decree, and the gloating of enemies.

152.title: Supplication Against a Bad Neighbor
152.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a bad neighbor in my permanent home, for a temporary neighbor (during travel) will eventually move on.
152.description: An-Nasa'i no. 5502. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

153.title: Supplication Against Envy
153.meaning: O Allah, purify my heart from hypocrisy, my deeds from showing off, my tongue from lies, and my eyes from treachery.

154.title: Supplication Against Worldly Temptations
154.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the trials of this world and the trials of the Hereafter.
154.description: General supplication for steadfastness in faith.

155.title: Supplication Against a Heart Lacking Humility
155.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that is not humble.
155.description: Part of the supplication for protection from four things.

156.title: Supplication Against an Evil Tongue
156.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my tongue.

157.title: Supplication Against the Evil of the Eye
157.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my eyesight.

158.title: Supplication Against the Evil of Hearing
158.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my hearing.

159.title: Supplication Against the Loss of Blessings
159.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the withdrawal of Your blessing.

160.title: Supplication Against Spiritual Diseases of the Heart
160.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from hardheartedness, negligence, humiliation, and poverty (of the soul).

161.title: Supplication Against Hypocrisy
161.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from discord, hypocrisy, and bad character.

162.title: Supplication for Protection from Shame
162.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, lack, and humiliation.

163.title: Supplication Against Cowardice
163.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from cowardice.
163.description: Part of the daily supplication for protection.

164.title: Supplication Against Senility
164.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from being returned to the most base age (senility).

165.title: Supplication Against Overpowering Debt
165.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.

166.title: Supplication Against the Evil of One's Actions
166.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done, and from the evil of what I have not done.

167.title: Supplication Against Enemies
167.meaning: O Allah, we make You our shield against them, and we seek refuge in You from their evils.
167.description: Abu Dawud no. 1537. Classed as Sahih by Al-Albani.

168.title: Supplication Against the Trials of Life and Death
168.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the trials of life and the trials of death.

169.title: Supplication Against Miserliness
169.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness.

170.title: Supplication Against Whispers (Waswas)
170.meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
170.description: Recited when feeling evil whispers in the heart.

171.title: Supplication Against the Evil of Created Things
171.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

172.title: Dua for Good in this World and the Hereafter
172.meaning: Our Lord, grant us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

173.title: Supplication for Firmness of Faith
173.meaning: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

174.title: Supplication for a Good End (Husnul Khatimah)
174.meaning: O Allah, make the best of my life the end of it, the best of my deeds the last of them, and the best of my days the day I meet You.
174.description: Supplication for steadfastness until the end of life.

175.title: Supplication for Ease in All Affairs
175.meaning: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty easy, if You wish.

176.title: Supplication for Sufficiency
176.meaning: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful to keep me away from what is prohibited, and make me independent of all others besides You.

177.title: Supplication for Justice
177.meaning: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.

178.title: Supplication to Avoid Oppression
178.meaning: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

179.title: Supplication for Safety from Oppressors
179.meaning: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.

180.title: Supplication for Strength of Faith
180.meaning: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

181.title: Supplication for Forgiveness of Wrongdoing
181.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

182.title: Supplication for Patience
182.meaning: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].

183.title: Supplication to be Safe from Wrongdoers
183.meaning: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

184.title: Supplication for a Blessed Destination
184.meaning: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].

185.title: Supplication for Forgiveness and Mercy
185.meaning: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.

186.title: Supplication for Spouse and Offspring
186.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

187.title: Supplication for Forgiveness for Self and Parents
187.meaning: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

188.title: Supplication to Keep the Heart from Deviation
188.meaning: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

189.title: Supplication for Good in This World and the Hereafter
189.meaning: Our Lord, grant us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

190.title: Supplication for Acceptance of Deeds
190.meaning: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

191.title: Supplication for Forgiveness for the Believers
191.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

192.title: Supplication for Victory Over Disbelievers
192.meaning: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

193.title: Supplication for Perfection of Light
193.meaning: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

194.title: Supplication for Expansion of the Breast
194.meaning: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

195.title: Supplication for Increase in Knowledge
195.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

196.title: Prophet Ayyub's Dua for Healing
196.meaning: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

197.title: Prophet Yunus's Dua in the Whale
197.meaning: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

198.title: Supplication for Good Offspring
198.meaning: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors.

199.title: Supplication for Protection from Devils
199.meaning: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.

200.title: Supplication for Judgment from Allah
200.meaning: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.

201.title: Supplication for Mercy from Allah's Presence
201.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

202.title: Supplication for Wisdom and Righteousness
202.meaning: My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

203.title: Prophet Musa's Dua for Guidance
203.meaning: Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way.

204.title: Supplication for Allah's Goodness
204.meaning: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

205.title: Supplication for Help Against Corruptors
205.meaning: My Lord, support me against the corrupting people.

206.title: Supplication for Being a Grateful Servant
206.meaning: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have turned to You in repentance, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

207.title: Supplication for Salvation from the Fire
207.meaning: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering.

208.title: Supplication for Protection from Hellfire
208.meaning: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

209.title: Supplication to Enter Paradise with the Righteous
209.meaning: Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.

210.title: Supplication for Justice Against Enemies
210.meaning: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

211.title: Supplication for a Good End
211.meaning: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

212.title: Dua of the People of the Cave
212.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

213.title: Prophet Musa's Dua Before Pharaoh
213.meaning: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

214.title: Prophet Adam's Dua for Forgiveness
214.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

215.title: Supplication for Perseverance
215.meaning: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].

216.title: Supplication for Allah's Mercy and Forgiveness
216.meaning: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.

217.title: Supplication for Protection from Hell
217.meaning: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering.

218.title: Supplication for a Comforting Family
218.meaning: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

219.title: Supplication for Firmness of Faith
219.meaning: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

220.title: Supplication for Good in Both Worlds
220.meaning: Our Lord, grant us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

221.title: Supplication for Acceptance of Deeds
221.meaning: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

222.title: Supplication for Forgiveness for All Believers
222.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

223.title: Supplication to Avoid Being a Trial for Disbelievers
223.meaning: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

224.title: Supplication for Perfect Light of Faith
224.meaning: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

225.title: Supplication for Ease and Contentment
225.meaning: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

226.title: Supplication for Increased Knowledge
226.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

227.title: Prophet Yunus's Dua (Al-Anbiya)
227.meaning: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
